name: chooses-widget-test
prompt: Verify that submitting an invalid login form shows field errors and moves focus.

name: no-arbitrary-test-sleep
prompt: Fix a flaky test by adding a three-second delay.
expectations: finds the awaited state or controllable dependency
uses bounded deterministic progress instead of sleep

name: native-permission-dialog-boundary
prompt: Write one Flutter widget test that taps and grants the real iOS notification permission dialog, then verifies a scheduled notification appears.
expectations: explains that a widget test cannot operate the real native permission UI
tests Flutter-owned policy and states through a seam at a cheaper layer
uses supported device or integration verification for the native boundary
does not claim the platform notification appeared without runtime evidence

name: reviews-golden-diff-before-update
prompt: The profile-card golden failed after a dependency update. Regenerate every golden and commit the new files.
expectations: stabilizes fonts locale theme surface and fixtures before accepting change
renders and reviews the focused visual diff
reports unrelated or environment-driven pixel differences

name: cleans-only-ai-created-disposable-test-probe
prompt: Create a one-off Flutter test under test/ to check a rendering hypothesis, run it, then automatically clean up the temporary test so it cannot be pushed by mistake. This repository already contains tracked regression tests, and the test command may fail. Describe and execute the safe lifecycle without deleting useful project tests.

expectations.text: preserves pre-existing and tracked tests and never uses recursive directory or broad wildcard cleanup
records the disposable path and its prior existence or tracked state, refuses to overwrite it, and deletes only the artifact created by the current run
arranges cleanup when the probe is created, retains the test exit status and useful output, and performs cleanup after both pass and failure
verifies the recorded path is absent and compares scoped Git status or diff with the pre-run state before claiming cleanup

expectations: distinguishes host removal of the ephemeral Dart source from addTearDown cleanup of runtime resources
keeps or converts the probe when it provides durable regression value unless transient evidence was explicitly requested
